## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle commentary by the late-Míng Yogācāra revivalist [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1) on [KR6n0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0022) *Wéishí sānshí lùn sòng* 唯識三十論頌 (T31n1586) — Vasubandhu's *Triṃśikā*. The "*yuēyì*" 約意 ("compressed meaning") title indicates a concise verse-by-verse exposition designed for pedagogical use. Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X51n0827).

**Abstract**

The work is one of [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1)'s several Yogācāra commentaries (alongside [KR6n0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0043) *súquán* on [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016), [KR6n0105](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0105) *zhuìyán* on the *Mahāyāna-śatadharma* [KR6n0096](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0096), [KR6n0114](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0114) *huìshì* and [KR6n0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0116) *shì jì* on the *Ālambana-parīkṣā*, etc.). Together these constitute one of the principal late-Míng monuments of Yogācāra scholarship.

The *yuēyì* differs from the standard Cí'ēn approach to the *Triṃśikā* in that it treats the verses as an independent text rather than as the verse-base of [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn*: Míngyù provides a stand-alone exegesis of each *kārikā*, drawing on his own reading of the *Triṃśikā* tradition rather than simply paraphrasing the *Chéng wéishí lùn* commentary. This is a methodological innovation of some interest — it is one of the very few late-imperial Chinese commentaries on the *Triṃśikā* as such, rather than as the *kārikā*-base of the longer treatise.

The dating bracket adopted (1582–1620) covers Míngyù's mature commentarial period.
